segments.note: The stimulus heading is replaced by the organized construction and boundary instructions; it carries no additional condition.
The witness heading is represented by assertion guidance and evidence, including the conditional side-effect check.
The verify heading becomes evidence entries retaining both counterfactual sensitivity and intended-cause checks.

activation.note: Activation retains Bun test scope, the three URN kind segments, and the absence-of-any-listed-signal detector trigger without restricting scanning to newly changed tests. File, language and URN facts are directly observable; body-level detection is honestly marked as requiring an observer. The any-signal detector exception remains distinct from acceptance-specific normative guidance.

audit.summary: All source knowledge survives at the claimed destinations, including the production boundary, acceptance-specific rejection, conditional protected-effect check, and verification guidance. The rewrite separates detector sufficiency from stronger test-quality guidance without adding waivers; its concrete example is inherited from the source rather than application-specific overfitting.

segmentChecks.note: The Stimulus heading is structural only; prefer[0] and prefer[1] retain its construction and production-boundary instructions.
The Witness heading is structural only; the rejection and conditional side-effect assertions remain in prefer and evidence.
The Verify heading is losslessly represented by the evidence section, which retains both verification checks.
The URN scope, mandatory rejection assertion, and complete signal list survive across given, then, activation, and verifier_detail.
Then requires rejection for the specific declared invalid condition, while avoid[1] rejects unrelated errors as proof.
The rewrite retains construction of the named malformed input, traversal of the production boundary, and assertion of refusal.
Prefer[3] and evidence[3] preserve the conditional requirement to verify absence of the protected state effect.
Evidence[1] verbatim preserves the counterfactual check that removing the declared validation would make the test fail.
Verifier_detail[1] explicitly says any listed signal satisfies the detector, and activation limits firing to absence of all signals without weakening the stronger acceptance-specific guidance.

unobservable: The body-level `finding` fact cannot be observed by Datalog alone; it is correctly marked needs_new_observer and requires bun_tester_discipline_detector to parse rejection signals.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the detector trigger and the stronger acceptance-specific testing guidance, including production-boundary traversal, protected side effects, and verification checks. A weak tester receives a clear decision procedure, and the only non-Datalog activation fact is explicitly assigned to a new observer; I agree with the auditor's PASS.
